arguments.explanation: No allergies or diet restrictions, so every recipe under 30 minutes is allowed, and all ingredients are in stock. The budget of S$8.00 cannot cover six meals. I counted your 10 eggs as about 500 g (50 g each) and used them as pantry stock. The cheapest 6-meal combination still needs about S$10.80: three tomato omelettes and three chickpea salads, which needs two 500 g tomato packs, two 400 g chickpea packs, one spring onion pack, and one cucumber pack. Every other mix I checked costs more, and the protein recipes cost more still (chicken S$6.50 per 500 g, salmon S$9.80, beef S$7.50, prawns S$8.90). If your eggs are heavier than about 60 g each (600 g in total), six egg fried rice meals would cost about S$7.10 and fit the budget. Tell me the egg weight or raise the budget and I will re-plan. Nothing has been ordered.
